name: Brennerpass
kurzbeschreibung: The lowest Alpine pass at 1,374 m – historic border between Austria and Italy with the Brennerbahn, the Brennerautobahn and a cycle path to Bozen.
beschreibung: The Brenner Pass connects Austrian Tyrol with South Tyrol at an altitude of 1,374 metres and is the most important Alpine crossing between Austria and Italy. For centuries, travellers and traders have used this lowest pass of the Central Alps as a north-south connection. After the end of the First World War, it forms the national border between the two countries. Today, the Brennerautobahn and the historic Brennerbahn cross the pass, linking Innsbruck with Sterzing, Brixen and Bozen. The Brenner–Bozen cycle path follows the old railway line through the Eisacktal for around 96 kilometres. The view extends far into the Wipptal and to the surrounding mountain worlds. The pass is passable all year round, but in winter weather and road conditions must be taken into account.
